title: Comprehensive Proteomics Reveals Pachymic Acid Targeting RBMX via hnRNPC Degradation in Colorectal Cancer.
snippet: Pachymic acid (), a major bioactive component of Poria cocos, suppresses colorectal cancer (CRC) proliferation and invasion by disrupting glycolysis. However, its antitumor activity and underlying mechanisms in vitro and in vivo remain unclear. title: In Silico Single-Cell Transcriptomic Analysis Reveals Senescence-Associated Programs' Progress Along the Normal-Adenoma-Carcinoma Sequence in Colorectal Cancer.
snippet: Colorectal cancer (CRC) develops through a multistep progression from normal colonic mucosa to adenoma and ultimately carcinoma. However, the cell-type-specific senescence-associated states during this transition remain incompletely understood.
